content.description:
✨ ONE PLATFORM, A WHOLE WORLD OF OPPORTUNITY

The best jobs have always clustered in a handful of the world's wealthiest cities. But talent is everywhere. Oyster set out to close that gap - building a global employment platform that lets companies hire, pay, and care for brilliant people anywhere.

We're proof that a high-performing culture doesn't need an office. Distributed across 60+ countries since 2020, we've built something the industry keeps noticing:

- Ranked #10 of 250 on TIME and Statista's 2026 list of America's Top WorkTech Companies https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-hr-named-10-of-americas-top-worktech-companies-of-2026-by-time

- Named one of America's Greatest Startup Workplaces 2026 https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-2026-newsweek-award by Newsweek

- A G2 Spring 2026 Leader https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-named-best-roi-for-any-global-employment-platform-for-g2-spring-2026 across Employer of Record, Global Employment, Multi-country Payroll, and HR Compliance

- The only B Corp-certified global employment platform ~ independently verified since 2023

Two of those rankings measured our business impact from the outside. One measured how our own people feel about working here. They landed in the same place ~ because at Oyster, culture and performance aren't separate conversations. They're the same one.

And we're just getting started. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who care as much as you do, we'd love for you to apply.

THE ROLE

Location: While this position is posted in a specific location, all of Oyster’s positions are fully remote and you can work from home. Forever. To create the best experience for our new hire (you?!), this role requires that you are based in the AMER region.

At Oyster, we’re on a mission to create a more equal world by making it possible for companies everywhere to hire people anywhere.

Joining as a Business Development Representative (BDR) is your chance to take your outbound experience to the next level and build a long-term career in tech sales. You’ll sharpen your outreach, qualify leads, and build relationships that drive real business results, all while working with top-tier sales tools like Salesforce, Salesloft, Nooks, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

Why you’ll love it here

You won’t be on your own. You’ll be surrounded by Business Development leaders, experienced Sales Executives, Revenue Operations experts, and an Enablement team that will help you ramp fast, sharpen your pitch, and keep improving every week. You’ll learn from people who’ve done the job and want to see you win.

AI-forward, and you own your process. Oyster is an AI-forward company, and our BDRs have real freedom to shape how they work. You’ll use the Nooks AI assistant (powered by Claude) and are encouraged to find your own ways to use AI to cut the busywork, so more of your day goes into real conversations with buyers.

Growth you earn. We take career progression seriously. Consistently hit your targets and you’ll earn protected time to build toward your next role, with coaching from BD leadership and our Enablement team. Your results open doors here, and we’ll help you walk through them.

Real impact from day one. You’ll be talking to HR, Finance, and Legal leaders at companies hiring across the world, helping them solve a problem that matters to their business. Every conversation you start feeds directly into how Oyster grows.

What you’ll do

- Generate pipeline through high-volume, multichannel outbound: cold calls, email, and LinkedIn

- Research and map target accounts with multiple stakeholders, then build tailored outreach to senior leaders up to the C-suite

- Qualify prospects and book high-value meetings that convert into real opportunities for your Sales Executive partners

- Clearly articulate how Oyster’s global employment platform solves the problems your buyers face

- Run your book like a business: manage your pipeline, know your numbers, and keep finding smarter ways to work, including with AI

- Be the voice of the market, sharing buyer insight back to Sales, Marketing, and Product

What we’re looking for

- 6+ months as an SDR/BDR in B2B SaaS, with outbound prospecting as the core of your role (not primarily inbound)

- A track record of meeting or exceeding quota (meetings, SQLs, or SAOs), and you can walk us through your numbers

- Comfort with high-volume outreach across cold calling, email, and LinkedIn, and confidence on live calls with senior leaders

- Experience prospecting into accounts with multiple stakeholders, including the C-suite

- Hands-on experience with Salesforce and at least one sales engagement platform or dialer (e.g. Salesloft, Outreach, Nooks)

- A genuine interest in remote work and the trends shaping the global workplace

You’ll thrive here if you are...

- Driven by a clear “why”: You’re motivated by more than money, whether it’s purpose, product, or your own growth, and it shows in how you show up every day.

- An owner: You take initiative, own your pipeline and your results, learn from mistakes, and find solutions instead of waiting for them.

- Always improving: You actively ask for feedback and put it into practice quickly. Here, that pays off: our Enablement team and BD leaders invest real time in coaching you.

- Resilient and persistent: You push through rejection, adapt your approach when something isn’t working, and keep the pipeline moving, and you’ll be surrounded by a team that does the same.

- A curious researcher: You dig into accounts, connect information from different sources, and use it to make your outreach sharper and more relevant.

- A team player with high standards: You lift your teammates up, celebrate team wins, and still hold yourself to a high bar on accuracy, organization, and results.

If you’re ambitious, curious, and ready to take the next step in your sales career in a global, high-performing team, we’d love to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK TOGETHER AT OYSTER

Our values guide the work we do, the decisions we make, and the culture that makes Oyster what it is. We make it happen—progress is our default setting. We drive change, we build and give trust, and we move as one united team.

Our mission is to create a more equal world of work: helping companies everywhere hire, pay, and care for talent anywhere. Everything we do ladders up to our mission. We embrace asynchronous, collaborative work and share how we operate in the Oyster Public HQ https://oysterhr.notion.site/Welcome-to-The-Reef-Oyster-s-Open-Source-Employee-Guide-fc482e3f107c4afd8c85ed217f1d0c1d so other global teams can learn from us.

HOW YOU WORK

With diverse locations, cultures, and needs, we created How YOU Work; https://oysterhr.notion.site/How-YOU-work-ac16c1932e314ffd8cb693e332458395 a program supporting your whole human experience at Oyster:

- Work from anywhere: Oyster has no borders or HQ. As long as work is timely, your team is supported, and you're authorized to work where you live, you can work from anywhere.

- Paid time off: Enjoy 40 days off per year (including holidays and vacation), or more if required by your country.

- Mental health support: Access Plumm https://oysterhr.notion.site/Plumm-3b5e7e70dec6428e975f68f25972cfb7, our mental well-being service.

- Wellbeing allowance: Each month, receive a wellbeing allowance in your ThanksBen wallet to spend on a wide range of options.

- Flexible parental leave: All new parents are eligible for at least three months’ paid leave, with job protection for up to 12 months or as required locally.

- WFH stipend: Receive a stipend for your laptop and home office equipment to get you set up quickly.

✨ THE BEST JOBS SHOULD BE AVAILABLE TO EVERYONE

We embrace diverse perspectives and intentionally build our product and company with an inclusive, global mindset. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every criterion, and are committed to a trust-based, thriving environment.

Oyster is committed to ensuring equal opportunity of employment for qualified persons with disabilities and actively fosters an inclusive work environment. If you require reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process, please email jobs@oysterhr.com with the subject line: Interview Accommodations.

Our available positions are on our careers page. Our team will only contact you from an @oysterhr.com email, and we will never ask for money as part of an interview process or job offer. If you receive a suspicious email about Oyster jobs or are directed to a site other than www.oysterhr.com/careers http://www.oysterhr.com/careers, please report it via our Compliance and Ethics Helpline https://faceup.com/c/8tpzyyye.
